mods.name: Logon Check
mods.description: Tracks player login activity and enforces inactivity penalties. Players must stay online for a minimum time (default 30 min) for sessions to count. Configure with game rules: logon-check:enable_logon_check (boolean), logon-check:inactivity_hours (integer), and logon-check:minimum_session_minutes (integer). Players inactive beyond the threshold are killed and banned on next login.
